block.conveyor_belt_plus.chute.tooltip.f: Supports smart filters from the 'FTB Filters' mod.
block.conveyor_belt_plus.conveyor_suppor: Click while building a belt to guide its turns or height.
message.conveyor_belt_plus.not_enough_ch: You need one chute per missing endpoint. All tiers in your offhand and inventory are accepted.
message.conveyor_belt_plus.chute_positio: A belt endpoint cannot be placed there.
message.conveyor_belt_plus.turn_too_shar: That turn is too sharp. Add a support or use a wider curve.
message.conveyor_belt_plus.port_used: That logistics port is already connected.
block.conveyor_belt_plus.chute.capacity: Up to %s stacks per batch · %s filter rules
screen.conveyor_belt_plus.filter_hint:
Click with a cursor item or drag an item from JEI to create a ghost rule. No items are consumed.
Empty-cursor left click selects a rule; right click clears it. Blacklist blocks matches; whitelist only allows matches.
Item, component and tag rules share the same limit.
screen.conveyor_belt_plus.components_hel: Edit Minecraft data components as SNBT. Only the ghost marker changes; real items are untouched.
screen.conveyor_belt_plus.cycle_tag: Cycle the marker's item tags, then press + to save.
screen.conveyor_belt_plus.apply_tag: Save this tag in the selected rule slot
screen.conveyor_belt_plus.no_tags: This item has no item tags. You can enter namespace:tag manually.
screen.conveyor_belt_plus.components_too: The marker's component data is too long to edit here.
screen.conveyor_belt_plus.rule_controls: Left click to select/mark; right click to clear.
message.conveyor_belt_plus.chute_upgrade: Chute upgraded; filters and connections retained
message.conveyor_belt_plus.belt_upgraded: Belt upgraded; items in transit retained
message.conveyor_belt_plus.upgrade_requi: Use a higher-tier belt to upgrade this route
block.conveyor_belt_plus.splitter.toolti: Buffers one item type and divides it evenly among connected outputs.
tooltip.conveyor_belt_plus.belt.connect: Right-click a start, then right-click a destination.
tooltip.conveyor_belt_plus.belt.interfac: Auto-installs chutes: offhand first, then inventory order.
tooltip.conveyor_belt_plus.belt.reset: Click supports to guide the route; sneak-use in air to cancel.
tooltip.conveyor_belt_plus.belt.upgrade: Sneak + right-click a route's start to upgrade; on a splitter, click its output face.
tooltip.conveyor_belt_plus.chute.summary: Attach to an inventory's side to load or unload a belt.
tooltip.conveyor_belt_plus.chute.open: Right-click for settings; new chutes allow all items.
tooltip.conveyor_belt_plus.chute.filters: Mark from your inventory or JEI; supports tags and exact components.
tooltip.conveyor_belt_plus.chute.upgrade: Sneak + right-click a lower-tier chute to upgrade, keeping filters and returning it.
tooltip.conveyor_belt_plus.belt.pickup: Aim at an item on a belt and right-click with an empty main hand; overflow stays on the belt.
tooltip.conveyor_belt_plus.splitter.capa: Buffers up to %s items of one type.
redstone.conveyor_belt_plus.always.help: Always allow container extraction and insertion.
redstone.conveyor_belt_plus.low.help: Allow transfers only without a redstone signal.
redstone.conveyor_belt_plus.never.help: Disable container transfers; items already on belts keep moving.
redstone.conveyor_belt_plus.pulse.help: One batch per rising edge; retain at most one pending pulse while blocked.
redstone.conveyor_belt_plus.cycle: Click to cycle redstone mode (applies to both input and output).
conveyor_belt_plus.configuration.title: Conveyor Belt Plus Configuration
message.conveyor_belt_plus.rts_forbidden: A belt endpoint is outside RTS action range or you cannot build there.
screen.conveyor_belt_plus.extraction.set:
Choose extraction sides
Select multiple faces; deselect all to stop extraction.
Only affects extraction from the attached container, not insertion.
screen.conveyor_belt_plus.extraction.sma: Not enough room for the side panel. Enlarge the window or reduce GUI scale.
screen.conveyor_belt_plus.extraction.ori: Front is the container face carrying this chute. Left/right are viewed looking into that face.
screen.conveyor_belt_plus.fluid_marker_r: Use a filled bucket/tank or a fluid from JEI as the marker
screen.conveyor_belt_plus.fluid_filter_h: Click with a filled bucket/tank or drag a fluid from JEI to create a non-consuming marker. Supports fluid types and fluid tags. Right click clears.
tooltip.conveyor_belt_plus.fluid_chute.s: Packages fluid from its attached tank onto a belt, or inserts arriving fluid into the tank.
tooltip.conveyor_belt_plus.universal_chu: Transports items and fluids on one belt; configure them separately with the right-side tabs.
tooltip.conveyor_belt_plus.fluid_chute.c: Up to %s mB per batch · %s fluid rules
Right click a glass fluid parcel on the belt with a bucket or fluid-capable tank to fill it.
tooltip.conveyor_belt_plus.fluid_chute.f: Mark filters with filled containers or JEI fluids. Supports fluid tags, redstone modes and extraction sides.
tooltip.conveyor_belt_plus.belt.insert: Right-click the belt with a held stack to insert it; fluid parcels remain fluid cargo.
